reviewer_scope: R2-7: single/ensemble ConvNeXt, DINOv2, simple averaging, residual fusion, calibration ablations
R3-3: separate fusion-design effects from model capacity and ensemble effects
R5-4: stronger ablations and simpler fusion comparator

Q1.question: What does fusion design add at fixed branch capacity?
rows: fixed lightweight linear fusion comparator OOF
full scalar-temperature calibrated residual pipeline OOF
W1/M1 strict nested meta-level result shown separately as selection-sensitivity reference

Q2.question: Does CNN+Transformer complementarity add value beyond simply using two models?
Q2.evidence_role: QUALIFIED fixed-HAM sensitivity; descriptive external replication

fixed_HAM_comparators.2C: all 10 unordered ConvNeXt fold pairs; equal-weight probability mean
fixed_HAM_comparators.2D: all 10 unordered DINOv2 fold pairs; equal-weight probability mean
fixed_HAM_comparators.1C+1D: all 25 ConvNeXt-fold x DINO-fold pairs; 50/50 probability mean

Q2.reporting: Report every combination plus mean, median, min, and max; no pair selection.

Q3.question: What is the effect of ensemble size?
Q3.definition: For each backbone family and n=1..5, evaluate every C(5,n) subset with equal-weight probability averaging.
Q3.additional_rows: 5C+5D simple 50/50 branch average and frozen 5C+5D residual-fusion deployment
Q3.evidence_role: QUALIFIED fixed-HAM sensitivity plus descriptive external scoring

Q4.question: Is the DINOv2 branch worth its additional computational cost?
Q4.key_comparison: frozen 5C+5D residual deployment versus 5C probability mean
Q4.reporting: Discrimination + parameters + MACs + checkpoint size + same-environment latency where defensible.

lightweight_comparator.features: same 14 log-probability features as residual MLP, followed by the same per-sample non-affine LayerNorm

class_weighting.formula: within each training split, raw w_c = n_c^(-0.35), then scale all class weights so mean sample weight over the training split is 1.0

lightweight_comparator.cross_fitting: five lesion-disjoint folds; train on four folds and predict only the held fold
lightweight_comparator.selection_rule: No second lightweight fusion method will be tried and selected after results are observed.

calibration_rules.development_OOF: Each valid OOF row may receive its own scalar temperature fitted cross-fitted: held fold k receives T fitted only on the other four OOF folds.
calibration_rules.submitted_residual: Use existing Phase12C1 cross-fitted calibration evidence for the submitted residual pipeline.
calibration_rules.mathematical_note: Scalar temperature preserves per-image argmax; therefore accuracy, macro-F1, balanced accuracy and recall are identical pre/post temperature by construction. Calibration contribution is assessed with NLL, Brier and ECE.
calibration_rules.fixed_HAM_external: No new temperature is fitted for 2C, 2D, 1C+1D, n-model ensembles or 5C using fixed-HAM, Derm7pt or BCN labels.
calibration_rules.fairness_rule: Raw fixed-HAM/external calibration metrics, if shown, are labeled uncalibrated/not-matched and are not used for cross-system calibration superiority claims.

P1.contrast: residual MLP pre-temperature OOF minus simple 50/50 average OOF

P2.contrast: mean macro-F1 across all 25 1C+1D combinations minus mean macro-F1 across all 10 2C combinations, recomputed within each lesion bootstrap replicate
P2.claim: descriptive confidence interval only; no confirmatory p-value

P3.claim: descriptive confidence interval only; no confirmatory p-value

Derm7pt.interpretation: Per-fold and five-fold-mean ConvNeXt/DINO predictions were frozen label-blind before diagnosis access. New W3 scoring is post-reveal scoring of pre-reveal frozen predictions; descriptive only.

BCN20000.interpretation: Per-fold frozen branch predictions exist. BCN was historically exposed; all W3 scoring remains retrospective descriptive evidence.

latency_if_new_measurement.device: same A100 environment used in prior efficiency work
latency_if_new_measurement.scope: model execution; preprocessing/data transfer separated unless consistently included for all rows

compute_W12_link.pareto_rule: Keep every valid configuration, including configurations that dominate the proposed system.

guardrails: No cherry-picking of folds, pairs or subset sizes.
No post-result switching of lightweight comparator.
If residual fusion does not improve over simple averaging, report that prominently.
If 1C+1D does not outperform 2C at equal model count, do not claim architectural complementarity.
If 5C dominates full deployment on performance-compute trade-off, do not claim DINOv2 is cost-effective.
Final title/architectural framing decision waits for W3 and W6 together.
change_from_v1.0: Added deterministic random seeds for bootstrap and any implementation requiring a seed.

This update was made before any W3 result calculation.
